headline: Revenue climbs on deliveries, but core profitability erodes
summary_short: Revenue rose 25.5% y/y to $28,236M on higher deliveries, while operating income fell 56.9% y/y to $398M as R&D and SG&A outgrew sales. Net income of $1,114M was roughly flat with the year-ago period only because a $274M California tax-valuation-allowance release cut the effective tax rate to 15% from 23%.
summary_long: Automotive sales revenue rose on higher cash deliveries and FSD (Supervised) subscription revenue, while regulatory-credit revenue fell sharply as related government programs were restricted. Energy storage revenue grew on higher Megapack deployments, but segment gross margin fell to 20.4% from 30.3% y/y on sales mix and unfavorable warranty adjustments. R&D spending jumped 49% y/y on AI-program costs and CEO-award stock compensation; SG&A rose 45% on the same award plus litigation and headcount costs. Operating margin fell to 1.4% from 4.1%. Net income was essentially flat only because a $274M valuation-allowance release cut the effective tax rate to 15% from 23%. Cash and short-term investments totaled $43.52B, down $535M since year-end. Management reiterated 2026 capex guidance above $25B.

drivers.explanation: Automotive sales revenue grew on ~25% higher cash deliveries and higher FSD (Supervised) subscription revenue; regulatory-credit revenue fell as governmental credit programs tied to Tesla's products were restricted.

Energy storage segment gross margin fell to 20.4% from 30.3% y/y as Megapack deployment growth was offset by a lower average selling price per unit and unfavorable warranty adjustments raising unit costs.
R&D rose 49% y/y on AI-program costs and CEO-award stock compensation; SG&A rose 45% on the same award plus higher litigation and facilities costs, compressing operating margin to 1.4% from 4.1%.

Net income held roughly flat despite the operating-margin decline because California SB 122 triggered release of a deferred-tax valuation allowance, cutting the effective tax rate to 15% from 23% and adding a $274M tax benefit.

Management frames the quarter around AI, Robotaxi/Cybercab ramp-up and Optimus development, noting that heavy R&D investment will pressure near-term profitability while operating cash flow continues to fund the business.
